whyItMatters: Random.nextInt is predictable in kotlin, so security values drawn from it can be guessed by an attacker.
actions: Replace Random.nextInt with SecureRandom for tokens, nonces, salts, and secrets.
For remaining statistical uses, add a comment stating predictability is acceptable.
Re-run the scan and confirm every security draw uses the cryptographic generator.
verification: Rescan shows no Random.nextInt feeding security values, and token prediction tests fail.
